title: Platinum Reserve Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document explains Platinum Reserve Account limits and mobile banking best practices: a $25,000 daily mobile check deposit limit and a $100,000 maximum daily outgoing transfer amount. It also provides procedures for staying within thresholds, handling rejections, and resubmitting adjusted deposits/transfers.
